text:
ana: Quick kickoff for the Orbit micro-launch. Test bundle = 90 free credits + 6 compact prompt templates + 20-min product walkthrough. Hypothesis: bundling live demo + templates increases 7-day retention by 7-12%. Need routing and two messaging angles today. :sparkles:

rolf: Sounds good. Proposed webinar Thu 9am PT. I'll own the landing + 2 reminder emails. Can draft subject lines by 3pm.

meera: Cohort split idea: 55% credit-only, 45% credit+templates+webinar. Want even regional distribution. Keep each arm ~900 users.

dave: Ops: recommend reserve for 250 concurrent viewers and fallback to hosted recording. @ops-bot can you confirm autoscale plan?

ops-bot: Autoscale rule active. Reserving extra group for peak window. Please confirm final expected peak by EOD. :gear:

ana (typo correction): sorry meant ana.

rolf: Routing pseudo-config (keeps minimal):
```
segment: new_user_0-5d
trigger: first_successful_call
actions:
  - grant_credits: 90
  - enroll_promptpack: orbit-starters-v1
  - schedule_webinar: +24h
metrics: calls_48h, promptpack_use_pct, day7_retention
```
Tag events with experiment_id: orbit_2024_q2 so Console filters are easy.

meera: Messaging axes: A) "Templates + demo to ship fast" B) "Build a feature with ready prompts". We'll A/B subject lines + hero CTA. Keep copy short.

rolf: Also plan an in-page Loom for no-shows. Short 5-min highlight clip.

ana: @growth-bot can you pull baseline day7 retention and avg token spend last 30d for new users so we can model cost per incremental retained user?

growth-bot: Baseline data attached in #marketing-assets: cohort_day7_avg=18.0%, avg_tokens_week1=2.3k, est_unit_cost=$5.75. CSV: orbit_baseline_1845.csv.

dave: CS plan: 2-email follow-up for webinar watchers with 3 copy-paste prompts and a mini case study. Also add in-product nudge for promptpack reuse.

meera: Measurement: primary = day7 retention lift. Secondary = promptpack adoption (3+ uses) and webinar watch-rate. Need a dashboard named "orbit_microlaunch" in Console. Rolf, can you coordinate with analytics?

rolf: Yep, will request dashboard and ensure experiment_id filtering. ETA next morning.

ana: Action items:
- @rolf: landing + subject lines + Loom clip (EOD)
- @meera: cohort sizing + seed distribution (tomorrow AM)
- @dave: confirm reserve capacity + autoscale (today)
- @ops-bot: ensure infra tagging for experiment_id (today)
- @growth-bot: refresh baseline after seed launch and attach run CSVs

ana: One last question: credit amount 90 ok? If anyone prefers lower/higher propose now.

meera: 90 looks good. Uniform simplifies analysis.

ana: Great. I'll post a one-pager for execs once dashboard is live. :white_check_mark:
